create_mustc_dataset: create a MUSTC dataset for a language split to load audio segments and utterances
extract_fbank_features: extract log mel filter bank features from waveform audio data for all splits
generate_manifest_tsv: generate a TSV manifest file with audio metadata and target text for a task
generate_vocab: generate a SentencePiece vocabulary model from training text with a specified vocab size
process_joint_multilingual: process all 8 MuST-C languages jointly to create a shared vocabulary and config
